flake-release Scope in: remove 'extend the direct daemon composition test'. State that the direct test of the release hook (a compose_daemon_flake-style function in squatch/daemon.py) lives in the fenced tests/test_flake.py, as heartbeat does with tests/test_heartbeat.py.

Keep tests/test_daemon_composition.py out of the flake-release fence and Context unless the shared harness truly must change. If it must, fence it, add it to Context, and re-measure the max-effort render against REQ_RENDER_HEADROOM.

flake-release must name the state that release mutates, for example a SHA leaving the flake-held set folded from flake_detected journal records. The criteria must then test that the flake_released append is observed before that mutation.
Define idempotence in terms of that named state: a second release of the same SHA appends no journal record and changes no state. Pin these phrases in the seed test's flake-release contract check.
If the plan does not define the state that flake release governs, raise a plan repair instead of inventing semantics.
